figurative_meaning_en: Utterly ruined or distressed, in a state of complete disarray
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভিড়ের চাপে সবাই নাস্তানাবুদ হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: The crowd pressure left everyone utterly distressed.
The weather ruined our plans completely.
note: This idiom vividly captures the sense of total disruption in Bengali colloquial speech.
